Cross-references followed only where L0 names them: the Autonomous binding at L7/peering/public/ingress/peer-1/object-1, PERPETUITY_QUESTION_ADJUDICATION §6.1, the 2026-08-16 ledger, AUDITON_ENVELOPE/HUMINT_ENCODE head lines, DISTILLATION lines citing AUDITONOMY.md, and aybllc/autonomous history for the bound blob and the origin of AUDITONOMY.md. result.summary:
Layer 0 on MAIN holds one authored object: AUDITONOMOUS_DEFINITION.md, a 410-line dictionary-style entry dated 2026-07-30. I confirmed it is byte-identical from the first commit through HISTORY, MAIN and ROADMAP. It has no version number. "Definition of record (AU-NORM-02)" is the owner ruling of 2026-08-16 that this entry is the active record and the consolidated [source text withheld from the public copy]; the ruling's own text is not in the repository, only citations of it.

The entry defines the adjective in three senses, eight criteria, a firmware clause and seven "is NOT" bullets, with six appendices. Its word roots were checked against external sources (13 VERIFIED, 1 PARTIALLY VERIFIED). Its corpus quotes were checked against abba-01/ebios, which is not in these clones. It never mentions auditon, lambda, compartments, conditions A–E or the Autonomous binding.

The other four L0 positions (epistemic, ontology, universality, pedagogy) are sheets only.

"Autonomous" is bound from aybllc/autonomous at commit 0504961. I confirmed the blob, the SHA-256, and that the file at its current path has the same bytes; "no rebind" means the pin was not moved. The bound entry is plural, not adversarially reviewed, and says "ten" over eleven rows.

ROADMAP adds AUDITONOMY.md, a later and different definition (2026-08-05, "v2 definition governs", labelled CONJECTURE) with five conditions A–E. MAIN's envelope and distillation files depend on it and call it "governing text", yet it is absent from MAIN and BETA. The restored bytes are a freeze-pinned version; three later versions exist in aybllc/autonomous history, one of which grounds condition B.

BETA inserts a dated paragraph and 14 role lines into the definition, additions only. That moves the "line 52" clause to line 54 while BETA's records still cite :52.

Still open: the line-52 edit, three Appendix D nits, the blend wording, eight versus twelve compartments, and two incompatible lambda_A definitions. The first thing to settle is which text the book treats as the definition: the 2026-07-30 entry, AUDITONOMY.md v2, or both with a stated relation.

MAIN files cite `definitions/AUDITONOMY.md` (once as 'governing text') although the file is absent from MAIN and BETA and the path matches no layout position.

AUDITONOMY.md cites companion files by another repository's old relative paths ([source text withheld from the public copy], governance/RULINGS.md). None resolves in the Auditonomous tree; five are at no current head of either repository.

The ROADMAP restore of AUDITONOMY.md used the freeze-pinned bytes of autonomous commit e27ca78 (462 lines). Three later versions (475 lines; 5c2b2e1, b8214ed, 9c123b0) exist in aybllc/autonomous history and are not mentioned in the restore record or the sheet. The restored version labels condition B's sources 'both unread' where the last version records them as read.
The bound Autonomous definition says 'the ten above' over a table of eleven rows A1–A11; AUDITONOMY.md repeats 'ten'; the Auditonomous binding sheet says eleven.

BETA edits the definition file in place, so the 'line 52' clause is at line 54, yet BETA's ledger, review sheet and adjudication still cite :52, and the AU-NORM-02 description 'restored verbatim, 410 lines' no longer fits the BETA file (426 lines).
BETA uses C6 and C7 for envelope compartments and for contradiction entries in the same findings file, and the L0 scope file does not say which series it means.
Three nits found by the definition's own verification (citation span, unmarked truncation of the RFC 4949 quote, unflagged constructed pronunciation) were never applied and appear on no pending list.
MAIN's sheet for the Auditonomous repository says 'In this exemplar, the L0 object is the locally authored semantic definition of Autonomous'. BETA changes it to Auditonomous.
The text of owner rulings AU-NORM-01 to AU-NORM-04 is recorded nowhere; AU-NORM-04 appears only in the commit message of 4a1c1db and in a ledger title.
Appendix D points to the full agent returns in a home-directory journal outside the repository, so the outputs behind the 'SURVIVES ADVERSARIAL REVIEW' verdict are not held.

Is docs/EINSTEIN_BRANCH.md present on ebios v1.0.0-dev? If it is attempt-branch-only, the firmware-below versus above-ROM contradiction (DEF:79 item 4) rests on a branch the owner ruled was only an attempt, and Appendix F's statement that only ORIGIN.md quotes are attempt-exclusive would be wrong.
Did the owner rule on BETA's handling of Appendix C (keep the quotes, add 'Current role' lines)? MAIN leaves it as 'the owner's edit'; I found no ruling in BETA's L0 files or its history record.

Has a prior-art search for the coinage been run? AUDITONOMY.md §6 says none ('NOT-CHECKED'); the HISTORY register cites a 'verified negative finding 2026-08-05' in FREEZE.md §1, which was not restored and which I did not open in history.

The AUDITONOMY.md anchors labelled VERIFIED ([source text withheld from the public copy], AU-5(2)) were not traced to their provenance rows; that belongs to the L7 scope.

BETA object-2 pins an Autonomous commit (805cd42) and a 7LM commit (4ca3edb) that exist only on unmerged beta branches of those repositories. Whether a binding to unmerged commits is acceptable is for the owner; I confirmed only that both commits exist locally.

result.summary:
Layer 1 holds three objects on MAIN, five on ROADMAP and four on BETA. All were written on 4-5 August 2026 by a model session on the owner's instructions. None has changed in substance since: the MAIN copies differ from the pre-prune tree only in table padding, and the two ROADMAP additions are byte-identical restorations.

AUDITON_ENVELOPE (twelve compartments, eight delivered, three legal freezes) is labelled [source text withheld from the public copy] has never been adversarially reviewed. HUMINT_ENCODE (slots H1-H7) is INTERNALLY DERIVED over quotations it calls VERIFIED; one of its warrants, [source text withheld from the public copy]. REQUIREMENTS_OWNERSHIP partitions 113 extracted requirements (E 21 / J 4 / X 6 / P 0 / D 82). I recounted ISO 24, IEEE 55 and NIST 20 from the extraction files; NASA 14 cannot be recounted from the repository, and the earlier 78-requirement run is still unreconciled. Its "sixteen of twenty-one are IEEE 7009" is contradicted by its own table (fifteen), and the wrong figure has spread to five other documents.

None of the five research objects is a pure Layer 1 object. The repository's own records leave three splits to the owner (decision D14, unruled); the two restored files have no split record at all.

Two ROADMAP-only files change the picture. AUDITABILITY_REQUIREMENTS partly answers the "blocking" question Q11, for SP 800-53 AC and AU only, and its AC counts do not close. AUDITON_REPLICATOR records that two headline claims were refuted and reopens the envelope's C2 root of trust and its platform/envelope split. MAIN and BETA carry neither, so MAIN's envelope cites a demonstration it no longer holds and BETA says Q11 is open.

BETA adds a small genuine state-space statement (four inputs, sixteen ordered pairs) with no label, date or sheet entry, and re-labels Q13 as UNRESOLVED/CONTESTED instead of a finding.

To do first: rule D14 and D18, correct sixteen to fifteen, reconcile 78 against 113, and have the envelope adversarially reviewed.

result.summary:
Layer 2 (formal mathematics) holds no formal object in the merged state. Its only file besides directory sheets is a formulas ledger that declares itself EMPTY: zero rows in the register, the composite table and the change log. The relations, operators and proofs positions are each "admissible and empty". No predicate for "auditonomous" is stated anywhere; "Aud(S,F)" was a slip in the roadmap's first version, corrected there by grep. The one exact result in the repository, a four-line isomorphism, sits in an L4 session file, unregistered. A formula inconsistency recorded inside the L0 definition is also unregistered.

Layer 3 (engineering mathematics) holds two documents. The Seal-Gated Interlock is a PROPOSAL: nothing built, its adversarial attack pass never folded in (no result exists in any state), IEC 61508 / ISO 13849 NOT-CHECKED, its trust regress open. The external priors file records quotations from Rump, Kearfott, Neumaier, Comba and Stolfi, and Stolfi and de Figueiredo on the dependency problem, affine arithmetic, partial dependency and condensation; one taxonomy is CONTESTED and two claims are unchecked. Its sources have no ledger rows and I could not re-fetch them. Approximation and tolerances are empty.

The roadmap branch changes nothing in these layers but says Layer 2 "must be filled first" for Part V. The beta adds a finite fixture predicate and an enumeration method, both self-qualified as synthetic, software-only and not proof of authenticity; I confirmed the stored 32-event result satisfies the predicate and that the pinned hashes match, but the beta did not update the sheets or the ledger.

The gap is wide: nine concepts the definition relies on (epistemic state, inability to conceal, the tamper-evident record, carried uncertainty, firmware-level enforcement, truth envelope, measurability, discretion, transformation path) have no formal statement and no method. First step: the owner registers or rejects the listed candidate objects.

result.summary:
The core review set on MAIN is small: two governance texts (a four-rung status ladder and a fourteen-label registry), one register of seven standards conflicts (C1 to C7), one adjudication (the perpetuity question), and a sheet listing four open author's calls. ROADMAP carries the same four documents byte-identical; BETA changes only CONTRADICTIONS.md.

C1 to C7 are comparisons of published standards, dated 2026-08-05. None is resolved and none can be by this repository. I checked C1, C2 and C4 against the extractions they cite. C1 is described accurately. C2 overstates: its own full entry makes the conflict conditional on an external authorizer. C4's heading says "identical" where its body says "near-identical", and the bound Autonomous definition lists the "Heteronomous" classification it rests on as still unverified. Every link in the file is dead on MAIN and BETA, because the cited files were renamed or pruned.

The perpetuity adjudication (2026-08-02) answers the owner's question with "No": the first leg FAILED CHECK, the second UNVERIFIABLE AS POSED, physical perpetuity CONTESTED, stop-then-go not required. What survives is a ratchet reading labelled CONJECTURE and one restated research question. Its recommended edit to the definition's line 52 is unapplied in every state, and a same-dated file (CYCLES, absent from MAIN and BETA) reaches the opposite verdict on whether audit is necessarily post hoc.

The "23 internal contradictions" (C-1 to C-23) are not in CONTRADICTIONS.md. They live in the consolidated AUDITONOMOUS.md, which exists only in HISTORY and ROADMAP.

Label use is loose: both review documents use labels in neither vocabulary (CONTESTED, UNVERIFIED, UNVERIFIABLE AS POSED), nothing is labelled PARKED, and the adjudication labels fetch-relayed quotes VERIFIED in some places and PARTIALLY VERIFIED in others.

The BETA section routes the autonomy side of each row through the bound Autonomous definition without re-verifying anything. That definition does not contain IEEE 1920.1, IEEE 7007, ISO/IEC 25059, ALFUS Volume II, or the two specific clauses C1 and C4 turn on.

First steps: rule on line 52 with CYCLES in view; rule which rows belong to Autonomous; repair the dead links; re-confirm the relayed quotes.

result.summary:
The lanes directory holds exactly three files, byte-identical on MAIN, ROADMAP and BETA: a sheet, a theme ledger and a record-ontology question file. Both research files date from one session (2026-08-02, one edit 2026-08-04) and have not been worked since; no LANE_* file exists.

The theme ledger groups the 52-block corpus into eleven clusters (C1 to C11) and registers sixteen tensions (T1 to T16); the sheet wrongly says C1 to C6 and T1 to T11. Every corpus quotation I tested (49 archive locators plus the outline, TOC, embodied-manuscript, eBIOS-draft and definition lines) matches, but only against ROADMAP or HISTORY: on MAIN the archive, TOC, blocks, embodied manuscript and eBIOS draft are absent, so C1 to C10 and T1 to T12, T15, T16 cannot be checked there. Only T13's definition-file lines resolve on MAIN. One tension is closed by the owner (T1, blocks 31/32/35/36 cut, after two admitted misreadings); [source text withheld from the public copy]") is open for the owner and carries the only outside-source work in the ledger, four literature lanes with recorded failures. T3's own count is wrong: the archive holds six claimants across all three verbs, not two. The other fourteen tensions are unresolved contradictions with no ruling. The embodied-manuscript hash FAILED CHECK reproduces.

The question file holds twelve questions (Q1 to Q9 with Q6a to Q6c), all OPEN. Q3 is the best supported (write-ahead logging, ARIES, whose reading record is on MAIN). Q5 and Q6c still say their lanes are running; the outcomes sit only in a docket that exists on ROADMAP and HISTORY, and one of them contradicts the owner's claim that autonomy requires forgetfulness.

For the manuscript, the owner's pending calls are: T3, the home of [source text withheld from the public copy], the placement of Blocks 37 to 38, the observer/observed definitions, and the definition's line-52 edit.

result.summary:
Layer 5 holds eight finding documents across the three states; the institution branch is empty by its own statement.

MAIN has three findings, byte-identical in ROADMAP and BETA. DISTILLATION gives six candidate laws, self-labelled INTERNALLY DERIVED · CONJECTURE, plus four prior-art lanes whose legal and economics quotations appear nowhere else in the repository. OVERRIDE_NECESSITY tests five propositions: audited override is supported, the single-recursive-loop claim is refuted, policy revision from the record stays conjecture, and the bootstrapping objection is unanswered. SEGREGATION_AND_FORGETTING finds segregation codified but unable to stop omission and in collision with the trace-before-actuator rule; forgetting-as-non-recall is supported and not novel.

ROADMAP restores four more, byte-identical to the pre-prune tree: AUDITON_PACKABILITY (not packable), AUTONOMY_AT_DISTANCE (which withdraws part of that), OMMP_ATTACHMENT_GAP and UHA_AS_MAP. I reconfirmed the cited code lines and recomputed the UHA table. BETA adds one finding from a 16-case synthetic run; I recounted its figures and hash-verified its pins. It claims only selected synthetic predicates.

Four source checks passed: RFC 6962, Haber and Stornetta, ARIES and IEEE 7014 are ledgered and their quotations are verbatim in the reading records. Against that, more than thirty cited works have no ledger row and no reading record, and one IEEE 7001 passage is called NORMATIVE in the finding but MIXED in its reading record.

Open contradictions: Q13 on MAIN says the envelope cannot be autonomous under two standards, AUTONOMY_AT_DISTANCE withdraws that, BETA calls it contested. The 78 versus 113 requirement counts are unreconciled. DISTILLATION still says "immutable" after OVERRIDE_NECESSITY ruled the word unsafe, and its replicator evidence was partly refuted on ROADMAP while the computation is absent from this repository. Every finding ends "nothing adopted"; none has a recorded review or owner ruling.

For the manuscript, the findings supply tested claims with their limits, but most internal citations on MAIN point to files that exist only on ROADMAP or in history. First: decide whether the ROADMAP restorations merge; then rule on Q13, EB:233 and the immutability wording; then ledger the uncited sources.

result.summary:
The lambda thread exists only on ROADMAP (and in HISTORY): none of the seven review documents, the DR folder or the probes is on MAIN or BETA. All fourteen files are byte-identical to their 1d83788 originals (blob hashes compared).

Two different things are called lambda. lambda_EB [source text withheld from the public copy] eb-stack product radius. lambda_A is a "decomposition state" in the auditonomous prior/residual/memory proposal. A same-author ruling says they must not be identified. lambda_A itself has two incompatible definitions (the thesis decode says "exactly known, zero uncertainty"; the departure protocol says it does not mean exactness).

Established, with outside sources: lambda=1 is Rump 1999's midpoint-radius product (cite, do not coin); the lambda=0 radius is exact for sign-definite operands only if the centre is shifted. I re-read both against the Rump 1999 text held in the companion repository and they match. Established internally: lambda=0 as coded (centre not shifted) is not an enclosure; the swap-flip has no left inverse (DR-003); centre decode halves the bound (DR-001).

Refuted: the "meaningful digit budget" storage argument; naive bit-exact pruning over a chain; three cosmology prior-art claims; "Dekker 1971 is held".

Open: which regime the book uses (owner decision D11); the lambda_A mechanism's undefined operators and unbounded accumulator; its novelty (no external source found for the mechanism, and a model-output run in the repository says the broad claim is already occupied); six unobtained sources; whether the quoted eb-stack code line is real.

The external audit (27 clusters) found 2 failed checks, 3 falsified blockers and citation defects. The OMMP README, the egress withdrawal and the ISO 15489 gloss were acted on; the Westby DOI, the Tic Tac framing defects, the Morton citation and the manuscript's Git and kilogram sentences were not.

Do first: rule D11; reconcile the two lambda_A definitions; file the missing scripts; fix the record defects listed.

result.summary:
All eight documents exist only on the ROADMAP branch and in pre-prune HISTORY. Each is byte-identical to its August blob, so none has changed since 2026-08-04 to 08-08, and none is on MAIN or BETA.

The research docket (2026-08-02, one commit) holds section 0, section 0a (two propositions) and 45 lettered entries. Five (H1-H5) are closed, three are marked HIGH PRIORITY (B2, D3, E1), and eleven wait on the owner. The rest wait on sources or on arithmetic that was derived and never run (A1-A3). I found no later record closing any entry; the external audit of 2026-08-04 refutes part of D3.

The author assertions (A-001 to A-009c) are the owner's positions. Their attached algebra reproduces by hand where I checked it, nothing external tests them, and two tables have counting problems.

The source-request list (SR-01 to SR-24) records three closures. At least four more requests have since been met or part-met elsewhere without the list being amended.

The census dossier is a plan only: zero entries verified, its stated cause (an egress block) disproved the same day, and one citation carrying an unregistered DOI.

The NASA-paper ledger records seven substantive defects in the owner's N/U algebra paper, chiefly that the product rule omits a term and does not enclose, plus one blocked attribution. The paper is not held in this repository.

The walk-across compares both repositories with a "definitional instrument" that neither repository holds.

The cycles document's two external verdicts stand, with two overstatements recorded against them. The propulsion adjudication's arithmetic was independently re-derived; its named physics results are unchecked.

The owner's ruling "scholarly only" survives only in HISTORY and is not carried into the ROADMAP's open decision D1.

First steps: rule D1 against that ruling; reconcile the source requests with what is now held; run the unrun arithmetic; fix the ISO 15489 gloss.

result.summary:
The source base is one pointer register plus a tree of records about sources. By my own count the register (MAIN L7/provenance/sources/LEDGER.md) has 60 rows, not the 62 the MAIN sheets state: 34 standards (IEEE 29, IETF 2, ISO/IEC 1, ITU-T 1, NIST 1), 20 papers, 4 IEEE institutional documents and 2 exclusions. There are no book rows and no government-document class; the LAW- prefix is unused. Fifty-eight rows are access FULL. Each points into the private archive aybllc/l6, 39 at commit b328334 and 19 at e4f0d5c. No source PDF is in the repository, but one full-text copy of a paper (the Ferreira numbered text) is, with licence status unrecorded. I could not resolve any pointer because l6 is not on this machine.

What the ledger verifies is file identity between the staged copy and the l6 copy, dated 2026-08-16. It does not record whether a source was read. Reading is shown for 14 of the 58: eleven full reading records (IEEE 7001, 7007, 7009, 7014, 3152; ARIES; Haber-Stornetta; Ferreira; FIPS 180-4; RFC 6962; RFC 9162) and three partial captures (IEEE 1788-2015 decorations, IEEE 1872.2, ISO/IEC 22989 from a withdrawn copy). The other 44 have none, and about 30 are drone, factory and networking standards the repository itself says do not bear on the word.

The reading produced findings that cut against the corpus and remain reserved to the owner: hash structures detect rather than prevent, tamper-evidence needs an external witness, and IEEE 7014's auditability definition was mis-scoped.

The prior-art search for the coinage was never run. The datasets ledger and authority position are empty. The definition's own external citations (American Heritage, Perseus, NIST glossary, RFC 4949, NIST AI 100-1) have no ledger rows. A third-party-licensed ISO PDF remains in git history, its purge recorded as pending.

First steps: adopt BETA's 60-row correction, ledger the definition's citations and SP 800-53, settle the ISO purge and the Ferreira text, re-check the 22989 captures against the lawful copy, then run the prior-art search.

result.summary:
The desk holds eight peering positions, one statement of copyright conditions, and a publications binder containing rules only. Nothing has been released in any of the three states: the press-kit and internal folders hold a README each, public egress is empty, and all six release-checklist boxes are unticked.

Bindings. One binding is pinned to a commit I could confirm: the definition of "autonomous" from aybllc/autonomous at 0504961 (commit exists; the file's bytes are unchanged on that repository's main and beta, at a new path). BETA adds a second pinned object (a finite computation result at autonomous 805cd42, architecture 7lm 4ca3edb); both commits exist and both SHA-256 values match, but both commits live only on unmerged beta branches. The archive binding (aybllc/l6) and the closed transfer to it cite commits that cannot be confirmed here because no l6 clone exists. Three bindings have no version pinned at all: the eb-audit departure protocol, the ebios repository with the Martin 2026 manuscript, and the pending Third Power Corpus transfer, which waits on an owner decision.

Governance. Every condition is stated once, in the copyright sheet: WSU-licensed IEEE files are hold-private (quotations may travel, files may not), the ISO/IEC 22989 captures derive from a withdrawn third-party copy and are not yet re-verified, and one full-text paper copy has no licence recorded. Licensing, patents, permissions and restrictions hold nothing. No licence instrument is filed.

Layout against the model. MAIN and ROADMAP still file publications/ and governance/restrictions/; the Seven-Layer Model's own main has used allications/ and governance/controlled/ since 20 September. BETA makes those moves. A local session commit dated today (f2d5b37) also makes them; it is outside the named states.

Record errors. MAIN says the source ledger has 62 rows; it has 60 (BETA corrects this). MAIN's publications sheet says a harmonized specification is filed in the writing folder; none is. The release checklist names two paths that no longer exist.

What blocks a first release: no item has been put through the checklist, the checklist's own paths are stale, unpinned bindings sit under the definition, the prior-art search is unrun, and personal paths remain in fifteen files including the definition.

result.summary:
Layer 6 in MAIN holds ten record files and two retired sets. The seven history files are byte-identical in MAIN, ROADMAP and BETA; ROADMAP adds two records and one retired set, BETA adds one record. None of these records checks a scientific claim: every ledger says "External Sources Checked: NONE". They are custody and layout records.

What I could confirm by checking: the 2026-08-16 commit counts (107 files, 62 deletions, 26 renames); the definition's 410 lines; both retired sets match their sheets; all 24 sampled move destinations exist in MAIN; ROADMAP's restore table is exact (318 paths; 116 restored byte-identical, 65 at HEAD, 16 superseded, 121 not restored); BETA's six moves and its finite-run numbers match its tree.

What is wrong or stale: the master ledger, which the README calls the master index, describes the 2026-08-16 layout; none of its areas exist in MAIN and it contradicts itself in three places. The "62 rows" count is really 60. One ledger sum gives 43 where the total is 40. Ruling AU-NORM-04 exists only in a commit message. The harmonization record says 69 paths moved; 68 did. Five owner drafts (.odt) were deleted in the 2026-08-15 prune with their decision still open, and the only later record cites a disposition that does not name them. MAIN has no enumeration of what that prune removed; only unmerged ROADMAP does. The model has since changed (L7/allications/, governance/controlled/): MAIN's L6 sheet still names the old paths, BETA fixes them.

Decisions: about 50 are recorded as the owner's. Roughly 10 are closed by a later record. The rest are open, including the three files that break the owner's definition rule (BETA claims dispositions, unmerged), the auditability-gap search (never run), the Third Power transfer, the ISO PDF history purge, and T3, Q1–Q9, line 52, §2.8.

First: decide whether ROADMAP's restore and BETA are merged, because MAIN alone cannot open what its own records cite.

Locator prefixes: MAIN/BETA/ROADMAP/HISTORY = auditonomous; AUT-MAIN, AUT@0504961, AUT-BETA, AUT-PR29 = autonomous; 7LM-MAIN = 7lm. No external source was fetched; no test was run; no quotation was re-verified against a standard.
result.summary:
Autonomous does not supply one definition of "autonomous". Its L0 object, AUTONOMOUS.md, is a plural entry: eleven codified definitions A1 to A11 from nine issuing bodies (ISO/TC 299, ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42, ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 7, IEEE, [source text withheld from the public copy]), plus five usage rules the entry itself labels INTERNALLY DERIVED. It says "[source text withheld from the public copy]". The Seven-Layer Model specification asks Autonomous to freeze a "consensus baseline"; none is stated anywhere, and the autonomous beta says so explicitly.

The entry's own status is contradictory: its banner says not adversarially reviewed, its status line says ADOPTED, its register says "not yet entered", and its review of 2026-08-08 (REVIEW_4) blocks the gate pending seven fixes that have not been made (A3 label cell, "A1…A10" for eleven rows, rule 2 unamended, rule 3 refuted on its own table).

Auditonomous is bound to exactly one object: research/definitions/AUTONOMOUS.md at commit 0504961 (2026-08-14). Every statement of the binding on MAIN agrees (seven places). The commit exists in the clone. I confirmed the bound file is byte-identical to autonomous origin/main today (blob ffbdc28, SHA-256 2756…a12b, 22,735 bytes); only the path changed. So the binding is stale in path, not in content.

Roadmap decision D22 proposed rebinding (to c9076c3, or to a tag exemplar-2026-09-14, or keeping 0504961) and recommended the tag. No such tag exists in the clone and PR #29 was never merged. The beta kept 0504961, declared "no rebind", added a provenance row, and added a separate object-2 binding to a finite computation at 805cd42; I recomputed both of its hashes and they match.

What Auditonomous still needs and does not get: a single baseline; the seven fixes; definitions it actually uses that are absent from the bound object (IEEE 1920.1 is nowhere in Autonomous); bindings for AUTOMATION.md and REGISTER.md; a settled meaning of "auditability"; and the unrun search on whether autonomy entails auditability. The baseline paper exists only on the closed PR #29 branch.

result.summary:
No chapter of the book exists, and nothing about the book has moved on the three named branches since 3 November. The roadmap (closed branch only) plans 27 chapters in eight parts; all 27 chapter files are headers ending "Not yet drafted", the bibliography says "No entry yet", and the build script was never run.

What the research supplies: every local file the roadmap names as a chapter feed exists on the closed roadmap branch, but on main 73 of the 133 feed citations point at files that are not there, and Chapters 10 and 22 have none. The roadmap's own labels put 11 chapters at RESEARCHING, 10 at CONJECTURE, 4 at SPECULATION and 2 at VERIFIED "(components)"; no external number in the first-contact chapters has been checked.

Of the seven build-first steps, the session-side halves of S0 to S5 were done on 14 September; every owner-side half (reading the two papers, the adversarial review, the merge and tag in the companion repository, rulings D22 and D23) is unrecorded. All 22 decisions stand unruled except D15.

The first drafting step, Chapters 2 and 19, is not ready. Chapter 2's register of standards contradictions is called "complete" by the roadmap, but the beta branch now calls several of its comparisons contested or unresolved, and the sourcebook withdrew its own seed findings. Chapter 19 waits on two unruled decisions, four unchecked sources and a source ledger that holds no first-contact source.

The vocabulary paper's claims table has one wrong row (16), one wrong line reference (3) and one overstated label (6); the other rows I could check hold.

The model changed after both beta branches were built: its manuscript guidance arrived on 3 November in commit 97314c5, and no branch of either repository carries it. Under that guidance the positions on the roadmap branch mostly agree; main does not hold the manuscript at all.

# Auditonomous: where the research stands, and what the manuscript can take from it

Read on 11 November 2026 from git objects only. Nothing was changed.

**States.** MAIN = origin/main 2165144, unchanged since 11 September 2026. ROADMAP = the closed branch of pull request #27, 9259c18. BETA = origin/beta/7lm-exemplar-auditonomous 714480d, committed 2 November 2026 (Pacific time). HISTORY = commit 1d83788, the tree before the prune of 15 August 2026.

**Short names.** DEF = L8/L0/semantics/definitions/AUDITONOMOUS_DEFINITION.md. AUDY = L8/L0/semantics/definitions/AUDITONOMY.md. RM = L8/L5/research/review/BOOK_STRUCTURE_AND_ROADMAP_2026-09-13.md. REV/ = L8/L5/research/review/. FIND/ = L8/L5/research/findings/. LANES/ = L8/L5/research/lanes/. SS/ = L8/L1/state-space/. STG/ = L7/provenance/sources/staging-records/. HIST/ = L8/L6/history/. AUT = aybllc/autonomous origin/main.

Words in capitals inside quotation marks are the repository's own labels. Evidence states in plain capitals are mine. Ids such as X-02 or U-01 point into the open register.

## The short answer

The research is a set of dated working records written between 30 July and 14 September 2026, plus one small computation of 2 November 2026. MAIN holds the definition entry, three state-space documents, an empty formal layer, one engineering proposal, three standards extractions, three findings, the register of seven standards contradictions, the perpetuity adjudication and the source records. The second definition (AUDY), the whole lambda thread, the research docket, the author assertions, four findings, eight numerical probes, the corpus and the roadmap stand only on ROADMAP. BETA adds a 16-case synthetic run and corrections to the records, and holds none of ROADMAP's material. What has been checked against outside sources is narrow: the word's roots, quotations from the standards and papers that were read, the lambda arithmetic against Rump 1999, and the claims sampled by the external audit of 4 August 2026. Nothing has tested a system against the definition, the prior-art search for the coinage was never run, and the search on whether "autonomous" entails auditability was queued on 16 August 2026 and never run. The live contradictions are two definitions with no stated relation, "concealment impossible" against the repository's own reading that records detect and do not prevent, three positions on question Q13, and eleven definitions of "autonomous" with no baseline. The manuscript can draw today on the definition as the author's statement, on verbatim standards quotations within their licence limits, on the two lambda results, and on the contradiction registers as method. It cannot draw on any claim of novelty, conformance or achievement, on any formal statement, or on any number in the first-contact chapters.

## The research, from the bottom up

**L0, the definition.** MAIN holds DEF: 410 lines, dated 30 July 2026, byte-identical since the first commit. It gives three senses, eight criteria, a firmware clause and seven exclusions. It is the "definition of record" by ruling AU-NORM-02 of 16 August 2026; the ruling's own text is held nowhere. ROADMAP adds AUDY, whose header reads "[source text withheld from the public copy])" under the label "CONJECTURE / INTERNAL ONLY". It defines auditonomy by protocol, law, sovereignty and immutable record, with five conditions A to E. MAIN's distillation calls AUDY "governing text" and MAIN's envelope cites its conditions, though MAIN does not hold the file. BETA inserts 16 lines into DEF and adds a scope note. The other four L0 positions are EMPTY. Evidence: word roots EXTERNALLY CHECKED (13 "VERIFIED", 1 "PARTIALLY VERIFIED", fetched 30 July 2026); senses and criteria ASSERTED; sense 3, the firmware clause and line 52 CONTRADICTED; AUDY CONJECTURE; which text governs UNRESOLVED. Verdict: there are two definitions and no document states how they relate.

**L1, state space.** MAIN: AUDITON_ENVELOPE (twelve compartments, eight supplied by the envelope, three legal freezes), HUMINT_ENCODE (slots H1 to H7) and REQUIREMENTS_OWNERSHIP (113 requirements split 21 / 4 / 6 / 0 / 82). ROADMAP adds AUDITABILITY_REQUIREMENTS and AUDITON_REPLICATOR. BETA adds a two-paragraph admission note. The envelope labels itself "`COMPOSITE OBJECT UNVERIFIED`. Not adversarially reviewed." Evidence: the composition is ASSERTED; the partition arithmetic is INTERNALLY CHECKED for 99 of the 113 rows, and the 14 NASA rows are in no file; "[source text withheld from the public copy]" is CONTRADICTED by the same file's table, which I recounted at fifteen (MAIN:SS/REQUIREMENTS_OWNERSHIP.md:72, 117); the replicator records two of its headline claims refuted and reopens the envelope's root of trust. Verdict: an unreviewed architecture over quoted controls, with counts that must be corrected before print.

**L2, formal mathematics.** EMPTY on MAIN and ROADMAP. The formulas ledger says "Currently: **EMPTY** — no formulas held." (MAIN:L8/L2/formal-mathematics/FORMULAS_LEDGER.md:10). One four-line isomorphism proof sits in an L4 session file and holds when redone by hand. Two readers reported that no predicate Aud(S,F) exists anywhere. That is wrong. I read the object: the sourcebook states it in LaTeX, as Aud(S,F) if and only if Aut(S,F) and five conditions (ROADMAP:L8/L4/work/writing/sourcebook/Auditonomous_Book_Material_Sourcebook_v0.1.md:116). It is model-written, unratified and unregistered. BETA adds one fixture predicate, which says of itself that it is not a universal definition. Verdict: none of the nine concepts the definition relies on has a formal statement.

**L3, engineering mathematics.** MAIN holds two documents. The Seal-Gated Interlock reads "Status: PROPOSAL. [source text withheld from the public copy]." It is UNRESOLVED: its attack pass was never folded in, and IEC 61508 and ISO 13849 are "NOT-CHECKED". The external priors record, on the dependency problem and affine arithmetic, is EXTERNALLY CHECKED as recorded, with no URL, fetch date, hash or ledger row. Approximation and tolerances are EMPTY. Verdict: one proposal and one literature note, and no method for any defining criterion.

**L4, computation and experiments.** Experiments are EMPTY in every state: "No experiment has been executed". MAIN holds three extractions (IEEE 55, ISO/IEC 24 and NIST 20 rows, recounted; EXTERNALLY CHECKED by their own single-pass record) and one deep-research report the repository labels "model output as run, never evidence". ROADMAP holds eight probes and the OMMP codec reconstruction, labelled "NOT CANONICAL". A reader re-ran all eight probes on 11 November 2026 and every compared figure matched the record that cites it. The codec suite passed 65 checks where its README says 66. On BETA, 12 tests passed and the committed result reproduced except for the recorded Python version. Evidence: INTERNALLY CHECKED. Verdict: the arithmetic reproduces, and none of it tests a system.

**L5, lanes, review, findings.** Lanes (MAIN): a theme ledger of eleven clusters and sixteen tensions, and twelve record-ontology questions, all "OPEN", not worked since 4 August 2026. Review (MAIN): contradictions C1 to C7 (quotes EXTERNALLY CHECKED as recorded, none resolved, every cross-link dead) and the perpetuity adjudication. Review (ROADMAP only): six lambda documents and three dated records, the external audit, the docket (45 entries, 5 closed), author assertions A-001 to A-009c (ASSERTED), source requests SR-01 to SR-24, a census dossier with zero entries verified, the defect ledger on your N/U algebra paper, the cycles review and the Tic Tac adjudication. Findings: three on MAIN, four more on ROADMAP, one on BETA. Each ends "nothing adopted" and none has a recorded review. Institution is EMPTY. Verdict: claims were tested and narrowed, and almost nothing was ruled or adopted.

**L6, the records.** MAIN holds ten record files and two retired sets, all about custody and layout. Every ledger says "External Sources Checked: NONE". The master ledger describes areas that no longer exist and is CONTRADICTED by the tree. MAIN has no list of what the prune of 15 August 2026 removed; ROADMAP's restore record lists all 318 paths, and a reader confirmed that table exact. HISTORY alone holds the freeze file, the hub ledger and your early drafts. Verdict: sound on custody, stale on the tree.

**L7, sources, bindings, conditions, release.** The source ledger has 60 rows, not the 62 that MAIN states. Each row points into the private archive aybllc/l6, which no reader could open. The ledger's "VERIFIED" means the file matches the archive copy. Reading is recorded for 14 of the 58 held sources. The definition's own citations have no rows. One binding is pinned and confirmed, to Autonomous at 0504961. Three have no version: eb-audit, ebios with the Martin 2026 manuscript, and the Third Power Corpus. IEEE files obtained through the university are hold-private. The ISO/IEC 22989 captures come from a withdrawn copy and are not re-verified. Nothing is released, and all six checklist boxes are unticked. Verdict: the base supports quotation from the fourteen sources with reading records and clears nothing for release.

## What has been checked, and against what

External checks on record, and what each settled:

1. Word roots, against American Heritage, Perseus, the NIST glossary, RFC 4949, [source text withheld from the public copy] IEEE 7001 scope page, 30 July 2026. Settled lexical ancestry only (MAIN:DEF:281-347).
2. Eleven [source text withheld from the public copy] on 4 August 2026: IEEE 7001, 7007, 7009, 7014 and 3152, ARIES, Haber and Stornetta, Ferreira, FIPS 180-4, RFC 6962 and RFC 9162. A verifier compared the quotes with the PDFs and found no fabrication. Settled: "[source text withheld from the public copy]"; tamper-evidence needs a second party; IEEE 7014 defines auditability for empathic systems only and requires deletion (MAIN:STG/library/FINDINGS_2026-08-04.md:12-36; MAIN:STG/ieee/FINDINGS_2026-08-04.md:18-69).
3. Three extractions, 99 rows, clause by clause. Recorded result: the ISO, NASA and NIST rows are definitional, and no body read states a least-function rule.
4. C1 to C7. A reader matched C1, C2 and C4 to the extractions, found C2 overstated, and found C4's "Heteronomous" classification listed as unverified in the bound Autonomous entry.
5. Lambda, against Rump 1999, Rump 2010, Goldberg 1991 and others, 4 August 2026. Settled: λ = 1 is Rump's midpoint-radius product; the λ = 0 radius is exact for sign-definite operands when the centre is shifted; the "meaningful digit" storage argument is refuted. A reader confirmed the Rump 1999 quotes against the copy held in the Autonomous repository.
6. The external audit of 4 August 2026: 27 clusters, "[source text withheld from the public copy]". Settled: the Git sentence and the kilogram sentence in the corpus are wrong, and three recorded blockers were false. Most corrections were never carried into the files they name (R-09).
7. The perpetuity question, 2 August 2026. Settled: no theorem says an autonomous system must end; the word has zero occurrences in five scholarly indexes.
8. Tension T3, against law and records standards. Settled: ISO 15489-1:2001 clause 7.2.2 lists five acts, and neither "falsify" nor "erase" is among them.
9. Cosmology as prior art for lambda, 5 August 2026. Settled: three claims refuted; only the conservation principle has precedent.
10. NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: 215 control statements transcribed, recounted by a reader.

Internal checks on record: the partition of the 113; the eight probes; DR-003, proved by substitution; the defect ledger's worked product, (2,1) ⊗ (7,2) = [3,25] against a true [5,27]; the bound definition's bytes, identical at 0504961 and on Autonomous main today; BETA's 16 cases, 32 events and pinned hashes; the restore table.

None of these checks bears on whether any system is auditonomous, or on whether the definition is new. No reader could re-fetch an outside source, so every EXTERNALLY CHECKED state rests on what the repository recorded.

## What is contradicted or open

**The definition.** X-01: two definitions, no stated relation. X-02: DEF:52 says "auditonomy makes concealment impossible from the start"; the adjudication answers "[source text withheld from the public copy]**"; a third file says audit is not necessarily post hoc. Your remark behind the pending edit: "the udiot is always post hoc." X-03: two senses or three. X-04: what the word blends. X-05: firmware below against an intelligence layer above the ROM. X-07: "immutable" stands after the override finding ruled it unsafe to claim.

**One reader disagreement, settled.** One reader reported the stop path as non-overridable in the envelope and refusable in AUDY. I read both objects. AUDY records your reversal of 5 August 2026, "NOt refusable", and restores the envelope's wording (ROADMAP:AUDY:42-46). What remains is X-13: MAIN's distillation still quotes "it may refuse or delay", and the file that records the reversal is not on MAIN.

**State space and findings.** X-08: Q13 has three positions across three states. X-09: packability against autonomy-at-distance. X-10: sixteen against fifteen. X-12: the root of trust. X-15: candidate law L5 against the replicator's own review. X-16: trace-before-release against a one-way carrier.

**Lambda.** X-14: λ_A = 0 read as "exactly known, zero uncertainty" in the thesis, while the departure protocol says "It does not mean numerical zero, exactness". X-17: the Autonomous finding calls λ = 1 exact.

**Unrun checks that carry the most weight.** U-01: prior art; AUDY says "**No prior-art search has been run.**" U-02: the entailment search. U-03 and U-04: the auditability extraction, and 78 against 113. U-05: no L1 object has had an adversarial review. U-06: the interlock's attack pass. U-07: ISO/IEC 22989 against the lawful copy. U-20: the λ_A operators, "named, none defined".

**Missing objects.** M-01: AUDY off MAIN. M-02: the defining manuscript off MAIN and BETA. M-03: abba-01/ebios, the corpus the definition quotes, in no clone. M-04: the NASA rows. M-10: every formal object.

**Not settled.** Whether IEEE 1788.1-2017 was read: one record says yes, two say no (X-18). Whether BETA was made by Codex: the commit's author is EDM and it carries no generator trailer.

## The dependency on Autonomous

Your rule of 5 September 2026 reads: "Auditonomous gets the definitions of autonomous from Autonomous and nowhere else." [source text withheld from the public copy] commit 0504961 of 14 August 2026 (MAIN:L7/peering/public/ingress/peer-1/object-1/0.md:13). A reader confirmed that the commit exists and that the file is byte-identical on Autonomous main today. Only its path changed. BETA keeps the pin and writes "no rebind".

What it supplies: eleven codified definitions, A1 to A11, from nine bodies, and five usage rules labelled "[source text withheld from the public copy] entry says "[source text withheld from the public copy]."

What it does not supply:

- A consensus baseline. The model's specification asks for one and no file states it.
- A reviewed entry. Its review of 8 August 2026 "[source text withheld from the public copy]. None has been made.
- IEEE 1920.1, on which Q13 rests. It appears nowhere in Autonomous.
- A settled meaning of "auditability". Its register lists the word as "CONTESTED".
- A binding for AUTOMATION.md or REGISTER.md.

BETA's second binding pins a computation at commits that exist only on unmerged beta branches.

## The manuscript against the research

No chapter has text. All 27 chapter files end "Not yet drafted." and exist only on ROADMAP. On MAIN, 73 of the roadmap's 133 feed citations point at files MAIN does not hold. The vocabulary paper's claims table has one wrong row (16), one wrong line reference (3) and one overstated label (6).

**Closest to usable.** Chapter 2 (the two contradiction registers), 3 and 4 (the eleven definitions and the level scales), 6 (the record-before-act literature), 15 (the lambda checks) and 25 (the perpetuity adjudication). Each still carries an open verification item.

**Waiting on a ruling.** Chapters 7 to 12 on D3, D4, D5, D6, D13, D18 and D20. Chapter 13 on the counts. Chapter 14 on D10. Chapters 15 to 17 on D11 and the empty L2. Chapters 19 to 24 and 26 on D1, with every external number unchecked.

**The minimum before the first drafting step.** The roadmap sets that step as Chapters 2 and 19 and puts nine moves before it. None has a record. The chapters' own needs are smaller. Chapter 2 needs a decision on what it presents: the roadmap calls the registers complete, BETA calls several comparisons contested, and the sourcebook withdrew its own seed findings. Chapter 19 needs D1, D21 and D8, four sources that are all "NOT-CHECKED", and a source ledger that today holds no first-contact source.

**Positions against the model's guidance** (7lm beta 97314c5, 3 November 2026). On ROADMAP the corpus, chapter files, sourcebook and prompts sit at L8/L4/work/writing/, as the guidance asks. MAIN holds no manuscript. The roadmap and spine sit at L5, which agrees. The referee report's criticism is filed at L4 with nothing at L5. The chapter headers copy the L5 roadmap where the guidance says to refer to it. No branch of either repository carries that guidance.

## The first ten things to do

Your instruction of 11 November 2026 puts this first: "we need to uipdate the autonomous and auditonomous repos phsyciall; to match first". It unblocks every merge. A local session branch of 11 November 2026 (ccr-9391bd81-f2enmj: f2d5b37 here, 8257118 in Autonomous) already mirrors the L7 restructure. I saw its file list only. It is built on MAIN, so it carries neither the restore, nor BETA, nor the 3 November guidance.

# Auditonomous: where the research stands, and what the manuscript can take from it

Read on 11 November 2026 from git objects only. Nothing was changed.

**States.** MAIN = origin/main 2165144, unchanged since 11 September 2026. ROADMAP = the closed branch of pull request #27, 9259c18. BETA = origin/beta/7lm-exemplar-auditonomous 714480d, committed 2 November 2026 (Pacific time). HISTORY = commit 1d83788, the tree before the prune of 15 August 2026. MAIN is an ancestor of both branches. ROADMAP holds all 169 of MAIN's paths and 159 more. BETA keeps 163 of them, renames 6 and adds 17. ROADMAP and BETA are the only pair where neither contains the other.

**Short names.** DEF = L8/L0/semantics/definitions/AUDITONOMOUS_DEFINITION.md. AUDY = L8/L0/semantics/definitions/AUDITONOMY.md. CONS = L8/L6/retired/consolidated-2026-08-04/AUDITONOMOUS.md (ROADMAP). RM = L8/L5/research/review/BOOK_STRUCTURE_AND_ROADMAP_2026-09-13.md. REV/ = L8/L5/research/review/. FIND/ = L8/L5/research/findings/. SS/ = L8/L1/state-space/. STG/ = L7/provenance/sources/staging-records/. HIST/ = L8/L6/history/. AUT = aybllc/autonomous origin/main. 7LM-MAIN = aybllc/7lm origin/main c9dc061.

Words in capitals inside quotation marks are the repository's own labels. Evidence states in plain capitals are my assignments. Ids such as X-02 or U-01 point into the open register.

## The short answer

The research is a set of dated working records written between 30 July and 14 September 2026, plus one small computation of 2 November 2026.

- **MAIN holds** the definition entry, the state space, an empty formal layer, one engineering proposal, three standards extractions, three findings, the seven standards contradictions, the perpetuity adjudication and the source records.
- **Only ROADMAP holds** the noun entry (AUDY), the lambda thesis and its checks, the docket, the author assertions, four findings, eight probes, the corpus, 23 internal contradictions and the roadmap.
- **BETA adds** a 16-case synthetic run and corrections to the records.
- **No live tree holds** the term ledger, the contamination rule or the prior-art search record.

Outside checks are narrow. They cover the word's roots, quotations from the sources that were read, the lambda arithmetic against Rump 1999, the external audit's sample, and bounded searches for the word. No executed test of any system against the definition exists. A prior-art search was run, although the repository's labels say it was not. Searches of 2, 5 and 8 August 2026 found the word not new and the definition unrefuted, but none reached publisher-of-record or standards hosts. The search on whether "autonomous" entails auditability was queued on 16 August 2026 and never run.

The live contradictions:
- four defining texts, with no stated precedence;
- "concealment impossible", against the repository's own reading that records detect and do not prevent;
- three positions on Q13;
- eleven definitions of "autonomous", with no baseline;
- 23 internal contradictions, never resolved.

The manuscript can draw today on four things: the definition as the author's statement, verbatim standards quotations within licence limits, the lambda results with their conditions, and the contradiction registers as method. It cannot draw on any claim that the concept is new, any claim of conformance or achievement, any formal statement, or any number in the first-contact chapters.

## The research, from the bottom up

**L0, the definition.** MAIN holds DEF, the entry for the adjective. It has 410 lines, is dated 30 July 2026, has been byte-identical since the first commit, and gives three senses, eight criteria, a firmware clause and seven exclusions. It is the "active definition of record (AU-NORM-02)" (MAIN:README.md:11). The ruling survives only as a ledger line (MAIN:HIST/LEDGER_2026-08-16_l6-close-and-normalization.md:32) and in commit 4a1c1db. It ranked DEF over the consolidated root file. It did not rank DEF over AUDY, which had been deleted the day before.

ROADMAP adds AUDY, the entry for the noun, labelled "CONJECTURE / INTERNAL ONLY". Its "[source text withheld from the public copy])" over its own five conditions, which it keeps as "anchor analysis" (ROADMAP:AUDY:3-5). ROADMAP's sheets state how the two headwords relate, but nothing says which text governs where they overlap. DEF:28 gives the noun as "bounded autonomy under mandatory auditability"; AUDY:69 gives it as "[source text withheld from the public copy]".

CONS adds two more defining texts. One is the constitutional sentence, labelled "the primary definiens" (CONS:70-74). The other is a fused form: "Neither is preferred here. Both stand." (:80-96). DEF quotes the constitutional sentence without its third clause, "a runtime without parameters". MAIN's distillation calls AUDY the "governing text" (FIND/DISTILLATION.md:21), but that path does not exist on MAIN or BETA. BETA inserts 16 lines into DEF. The other four L0 positions are EMPTY.

- The roots are EXTERNALLY CHECKED: 13 "VERIFIED" and 1 "PARTIALLY VERIFIED", on 30 July 2026.
- The senses and criteria are ASSERTED.
- Sense 3, the firmware clause, line 52 and the noun's gloss are CONTRADICTED.
- AUDY is CONJECTURE.

**L1, state space.** MAIN holds three documents:

**L2, formal mathematics.** EMPTY on MAIN and ROADMAP: "Currently: **EMPTY** — no formulas held." (MAIN:L8/L2/formal-mathematics/FORMULAS_LEDGER.md:10). **L5, lanes, review, findings.** Lanes (MAIN): eleven clusters, sixteen tensions and twelve record-ontology questions, all "OPEN" and untouched since 4 August 2026.

result.report:
# Auditonomous: where the research stands, and what the manuscript can take from it

Read on 11 November 2026 from git objects only. Nothing was changed.

**States.** MAIN = origin/main 2165144, unchanged since 11 September 2026. ROADMAP = the closed branch of pull request #27, 9259c18. BETA = origin/beta/7lm-exemplar-auditonomous 714480d, committed 2 November 2026 (Pacific time). HISTORY = commit 1d83788, the tree before the prune of 15 August 2026. MAIN is an ancestor of both branches. ROADMAP holds all 169 of MAIN's paths and 159 more. BETA keeps 163 of them, renames 6 and adds 17. ROADMAP and BETA are the only pair where neither contains the other.

**Short names.** DEF = L8/L0/semantics/definitions/AUDITONOMOUS_DEFINITION.md. AUDY = L8/L0/semantics/definitions/AUDITONOMY.md. CONS = L8/L6/retired/consolidated-2026-08-04/AUDITONOMOUS.md (ROADMAP). RM = L8/L5/research/review/BOOK_STRUCTURE_AND_ROADMAP_2026-09-13.md. REV/ = L8/L5/research/review/. FIND/ = L8/L5/research/findings/. SS/ = L8/L1/state-space/. STG/ = L7/provenance/sources/staging-records/. HIST/ = L8/L6/history/. AUT = aybllc/autonomous origin/main. 7LM-MAIN = aybllc/7lm origin/main c9dc061.

Words in capitals inside quotation marks are the repository's own labels. Evidence states in plain capitals are my assignments. Ids such as X-02 or U-01 point into the open register.

## The short answer

The research is a set of dated working records written between 30 July and 14 September 2026, plus one small computation of 2 November 2026.

- **MAIN holds** the definition entry, the state space, an empty formal layer, one engineering proposal, three standards extractions, three findings, the seven standards contradictions, the perpetuity adjudication and the source records.
- **Only ROADMAP holds** the noun entry (AUDY), the lambda thesis and its checks, the docket, the author assertions, four findings, eight probes, the corpus, 23 internal contradictions and the roadmap.
- **BETA adds** a 16-case synthetic run and corrections to the records.
- **No live tree holds** the term ledger, the contamination rule or the prior-art search record.

Outside checks are narrow. They cover the word's roots, quotations from the sources that were read, the lambda arithmetic against Rump 1999, the external audit's sample, and bounded searches for the word. No executed test of any system against the definition exists. A prior-art search was run, although the repository's labels say it was not. Searches of 2, 5 and 8 August 2026 found the word not new and the definition unrefuted, but none reached publisher-of-record or standards hosts. The search on whether "autonomous" entails auditability was queued on 16 August 2026 and never run.

The live contradictions:
- four defining texts, with no stated precedence;
- "concealment impossible", against the repository's own reading that records detect and do not prevent;
- three positions on Q13;
- eleven definitions of "autonomous", with no baseline;
- 23 internal contradictions, never resolved.

The manuscript can draw today on four things: the definition as the author's statement, verbatim standards quotations within licence limits, the lambda results with their conditions, and the contradiction registers as method. It cannot draw on any claim that the concept is new, any claim of conformance or achievement, any formal statement, or any number in the first-contact chapters.

## The research, from the bottom up

**L0, the definition.** MAIN holds DEF, the entry for the adjective. It has 410 lines, is dated 30 July 2026, has been byte-identical since the first commit, and gives three senses, eight criteria, a firmware clause and seven exclusions. It is the "active definition of record (AU-NORM-02)" (MAIN:README.md:11). The ruling survives only as a ledger line (MAIN:HIST/LEDGER_2026-08-16_l6-close-and-normalization.md:32) and in commit 4a1c1db. It ranked DEF over the consolidated root file. It did not rank DEF over AUDY, which had been deleted the day before.

ROADMAP adds AUDY, the entry for the noun, labelled "CONJECTURE / INTERNAL ONLY". Its "[source text withheld from the public copy])" over its own five conditions, which it keeps as "anchor analysis" (ROADMAP:AUDY:3-5). ROADMAP's sheets state how the two headwords relate, but nothing says which text governs where they overlap. DEF:28 gives the noun as "bounded autonomy under mandatory auditability"; AUDY:69 gives it as "[source text withheld from the public copy]".

CONS adds two more defining texts. One is the constitutional sentence, labelled "the primary definiens" (CONS:70-74). The other is a fused form: "Neither is preferred here. Both stand." (:80-96). DEF quotes the constitutional sentence without its third clause, "a runtime without parameters". MAIN's distillation calls AUDY the "governing text" (FIND/DISTILLATION.md:21), but that path does not exist on MAIN or BETA. BETA inserts 16 lines into DEF. The other four L0 positions are EMPTY.

Evidence:
- The roots are EXTERNALLY CHECKED: 13 "VERIFIED" and 1 "PARTIALLY VERIFIED", on 30 July 2026.
- The senses and criteria are ASSERTED.
- Sense 3, the firmware clause, line 52 and the noun's gloss are CONTRADICTED.
- AUDY is CONJECTURE.
- Which text takes precedence is UNRESOLVED.

Verdict: four defining texts, and no precedence among them.

**L1, state space.** MAIN holds three documents:
- AUDITON_ENVELOPE: twelve compartments, eight supplied by the envelope, three legal freezes.
- HUMINT_ENCODE: H1 to H7.
- REQUIREMENTS_OWNERSHIP: 113 requirements, split 21 / 4 / 6 / 0 / 82.

ROADMAP adds AUDITABILITY_REQUIREMENTS and AUDITON_REPLICATOR. BETA adds a short admission note. The envelope labels itself "`COMPOSITE OBJECT UNVERIFIED`. Not adversarially reviewed."

Evidence:
- The composition is ASSERTED.
- The partition is INTERNALLY CHECKED for 99 rows.
- The 14 NASA rows exist only in a workflow journal outside the repository (SS/REQUIREMENTS_OWNERSHIP.md:12-14).
- "[source text withheld from the public copy]" (:117) and "76%" (:264) are CONTRADICTED by the same file's line 72 and table, which give fifteen, or 71%.
- The replicator's review refuted "two of three headline claims" (HISTORY:manuscripts/definitions/REGISTER.md:14), and the replicator reopens the envelope's root of trust.

Verdict: an unreviewed architecture over quoted controls, with counts that must be corrected before print.

**L2, formal mathematics.** EMPTY on MAIN and ROADMAP: "Currently: **EMPTY** — no formulas held." (MAIN:L8/L2/formal-mathematics/FORMULAS_LEDGER.md:10). The sheets name two candidates that are not registered. One is the isomorphism (ℝ≥0,+) ≅ ((0,1],×), whose four-line proof holds when redone by hand. The other is the perpetuity argument.

A predicate for the word exists. It is model-written, unratified and unregistered: [source text withheld from the public copy] (ROADMAP:L8/L4/work/writing/sourcebook/Auditonomous_Book_Material_Sourcebook_v0.1.md:113-132). It also sits inside auditnomous-main.docx in all three states. The repository's own log flags it: "[source text withheld from the public copy]" (ROADMAP:L8/L4/work/writing/sessions/SESSION_2026-08-05_VERIFICATION_LOG.md:134). The vocabulary paper (:305) and RM (:583, :647) record that no such predicate occurs. That negative finding is CONTRADICTED: the predicate is written `\operatorname{Aud}`, which a literal search misses.

Two other if-and-only-if forms are also unregistered: AUDY:197, with conditions A to E, and "AuditonomousAction(α) ⇔ …" in the chat .docx files. BETA files a fixture predicate, while BETA's own L2 sheets say nothing is filed (CONTRADICTED). 7LM-MAIN's specification keeps "the project's formulas for life" out of L2 and places them at L3 when applied (spec :607-609).

Verdict: no registered formal statement exists, and the one predicate on offer is ASSERTED and CONTRADICTED.

**L3, engineering mathematics.** The Seal-Gated Interlock reads "Status: PROPOSAL. [source text withheld from the public copy]." It is UNRESOLVED: its attack pass was never folded in, and IEC 61508 and ISO 13849 are "NOT-CHECKED". The external priors record is EXTERNALLY CHECKED as recorded, but has no URL, fetch date, hash or ledger row. Approximation and tolerances are EMPTY. Verdict: no method exists for any defining criterion.

**L4, computation and experiments.** Experiments are EMPTY in every state: "No experiment has been executed". The definition disclaims achievement, not testing (MAIN:DEF:57). The desk comparisons that exist all conclude that the system does not satisfy the definition:
- eBIOS, against the firmware clause (MAIN:DEF:47, :252);
- NASA DSA/Starling, in ROADMAP's Master Archive (:312-314);
- the SpudCell, which "fails almost every clause" (Master Archive :486).

MAIN holds the three extractions, EXTERNALLY CHECKED by their own single-pass record, and a deep-research report labelled "model output as run, never evidence".

ROADMAP's eight probes and the OMMP codec ("NOT CANONICAL") were re-run on 11 November 2026. Every compared probe figure matched its record. The codec suite passed 65 checks, where its README says 66.

BETA's fixture runs 16 synthetic cases and 32 events against two selected predicates, C6 stop and C7 record, "not full auditonomous meaning". All four of its *_achieved flags are false, and standards_autonomy is "unresolved". Its 12 tests passed, and the result reproduced except for the Python version.

Evidence: INTERNALLY CHECKED. Verdict: the arithmetic reproduces, and none of it tests a system.

**L5, lanes, review, findings.** Lanes (MAIN): eleven clusters, sixteen tensions and twelve record-ontology questions, all "OPEN" and untouched since 4 August 2026.

Review, on MAIN:
- C1 to C7. The quotes are EXTERNALLY CHECKED as recorded, none is resolved, and the cross-links are dead.
- The perpetuity adjudication.
- The catch-all's "#autonomous(1).txt". It is a 2025 draft, "Autonomous Theory: Post-Biological Intelligence" (CONJECTURE, unlabelled). From about line 636 it continues as a raw chat export carrying an account identifier and seven e-mail addresses, some of them third parties'. That export is now in every state's history.

Review, on ROADMAP only:
- six lambda documents and three dated records;
- the external audit;
- the docket, with 45 entries, 5 closed;
- author assertions A-001 to A-009c (ASSERTED);
- source requests SR-01 to SR-24;
- a census dossier with nothing verified;
- the defect ledger on your N/U algebra paper;
- the cycles review and the Tic Tac adjudication;
- CONS §11's 23 internal contradictions, "None resolved. None ranked." (:1117-1183). They are filed as retired, yet RM uses them as a feed.

Findings: three on MAIN, four more on ROADMAP, one on BETA. Each ends "nothing adopted", and none has a recorded review. Institution is EMPTY.

Verdict: claims were tested and narrowed, and almost nothing was ruled.

**L6, the records.** MAIN holds ten record files and two retired sets, all on custody and layout. Every ledger says "External Sources Checked: NONE". The master ledger is CONTRADICTED by the tree. ROADMAP's restore record lists all 318 pre-prune paths, and the list is exact.

Only HISTORY holds the freeze file, the hub ledger, your early drafts, and research the restore left out:
- the term ledger AUTONOMOUS_TERMS.md, T-01 to T-25, all "UNVERIFIED";
- TERM_LANES.md, the only per-term record of what was read at source;
- the root AUTONOMOUS.md;
- the definitions REGISTER.md;
- intake/MANIFEST.md, "[source text withheld from the public copy]", which limits DEF's claims about where the word appears.

The restore record says the peer holds the term ledger (ROADMAP:HIST/restore-2026-09-14.md:230-231). No Autonomous ref does (CONTRADICTED). The freeze file's contamination rule includes "[source text withheld from the public copy]." (HISTORY:FREEZE.md:65). It stands in no live tree.

Verdict: sound on custody, stale on the tree.

**L7, sources, bindings, conditions, release.** The source ledger has 60 rows, not the 62 that MAIN's sheets state. One sheet also says "The ledger has no rows" (L7/provenance/sources/0.md:55), and the ledger counts 27 staging records where 25 exist. BETA corrects the count to 60 and adds AUT-SOURCE-001.

Fifty-eight rows point into aybllc/l6, which is labelled "private/INTERNAL" and was not available for this reading. Two exclusion rows are "HELD OUT of l6". In the ledger, "VERIFIED" means the staged file matched the archive copy. One such row reads "NOT READ" (PR-002).

Reading is recorded for 14 of the 58 held sources. Two of those records are limited: the IEEE 1788-2015 record covers decorations only, and the ISO/IEC 22989 captures come from a withdrawn copy and have not been re-verified.

The definition's dictionary, NIST, RFC and AI 100-1 citations have no rows. IEEE 7001 has row STD-004, but DEF cites the catalogue page instead. SP 800-53 has no row. HISTORY's _STAGING_TO_L6/ holds staged PDFs that no live tree holds, among them IEEE 7009-2024, 1920.1 and 1788.1-2017, all hold-private.

One binding is pinned and confirmed, to Autonomous at 0504961. Three have no version: eb-audit, ebios with the Martin 2026 manuscript, and the Third Power Corpus. Nothing is released, and all six checklist boxes are unticked.

Verdict: the base supports quotation from the fourteen sources that were read, and clears nothing for release.

## What has been checked, and against what

External checks on record, and what each settled:

1. **Word roots**, 30 July 2026, against American Heritage, Perseus, the NIST glossary, RFC 4949, [source text withheld from the public copy] IEEE 7001 scope page. This settled lexical ancestry only (MAIN:DEF:281-347).
2. **Eleven [source text withheld from the public copy]**, 4 August 2026, in two intakes. A verifier found no fabrication.
   - Library intake: ARIES, Haber and Stornetta, Ferreira, FIPS 180-4, RFC 6962, RFC 9162. Its finding: "**[source text withheld from the public copy].**" (MAIN:STG/library/FINDINGS_2026-08-04.md:62). The finding is aimed at the Git claim and the constitutional sentence, not at DEF, and is labelled "CONTESTED", "NOT ADOPTED".
   - IEEE intake: 7001, 7007, 7009, 7014, 3152. 7001 calls for an independent recorder of "**non-modifiable** data" (MAIN:STG/ieee/FINDINGS_2026-08-04.md:107). 7014 defines auditability for empathic systems only, and requires deletion.
3. **Three extractions, 99 rows.** The ISO, NASA and NIST rows are definitional. No body read states a least-function rule.
4. **C1 to C7.** C1, C2 and C4 match the extractions. C2 is overstated. C4's "Heteronomous" is unverified in the bound entry.
5. **Lambda**, 4 August 2026, against Rump 1999 and others.
   - λ = 1 is Rump's midpoint-radius product, and it encloses in exact arithmetic ("ESTABLISHED").
   - The λ = 0 radius is exact for sign-definite operands ("EXTERNALLY VERIFIED"). The interval is exact only with the centre shifted, and that shift is the repository's own step.
   - The "meaningful digit" argument is refuted.
   - The Rump 1999 quotes match Autonomous's copy (AUT:L7/provenance/prior-art/prior-art-lane/ru99.txt:117, :165-172).
   - Rump 2010 is not held, floating-point rounding is unchecked, and the adversarial pass has no recorded outcome (U-18).
6. **The external audit**, 4 August 2026: "[source text withheld from the public copy] Git and kilogram sentences are wrong, and three blockers were false. Most corrections never reached the files concerned (R-09).
7. **Perpetuity**, 2 August 2026 (REV/PERPETUITY_QUESTION_ADJUDICATION.md:91-100).
   - No theorem says an autonomous system must end.
   - The words have zero occurrences in five scholarly indexes and in Google Patents.
   - A 2018 blog, "a **prohibited source**", defeats "absolute lexical novelty of the noun".
8. **Prior art**, 5 and 8 August 2026.
   - Standards indexes: "PARTIALLY CHECKED — negative" (ROADMAP:REV/WALK_ACROSS_repo-instrument-standards_2026-08-05.md:42).
   - 30 IEEE PDFs: zero hits (HISTORY:FREEZE.md:17-28).
   - A 260-line record of 8 August: "coinage not superseded; lexical novelty refuted; definitional novelty unrefuted". It was deleted from Autonomous at ab8f01f. Its verdict is kept at AUT:HIST/HUB_SURVEY_2026-08-14.md:951-970.
9. **T3.** ISO 15489-1:2001 clause 7.2.2 lists five acts, and neither "falsify" nor "erase" is among them.
10. **Cosmology as prior art for lambda.** Three claims refuted.
11. **NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5.** 215 control statements transcribed and recounted. No ledger row.

Internal checks on record:
- the 99 partition rows;
- the probes;
- DR-003;
- the defect ledger's (2,1) ⊗ (7,2) = [3,25], against a true [5,27];
- λ = 0 as coded, which fails whenever both radii are nonzero. The code line it was tested on is itself "UNVERIFIED" as eb-stack's code.
- the bound definition's bytes, identical at 0504961 and on Autonomous main;
- BETA's 16 cases;
- the restore table;
- a string search, recorded only in two unmerged papers, that found no record, audit, log, trace or account term in the eleven definitions. "Oversight" occurs in four of them.

None of this bears on whether any system is auditonomous. Every EXTERNALLY CHECKED state rests on what the repository recorded. Only the Rump 1999 quotes were compared again.

## What is contradicted or open

claims_not_standing.reasoning:
Every cited locator resolves and every quoted string is verbatim, but three parts of the claim are imprecise or overstated.

CONFIRMED
- MAIN:L8/L0/semantics/definitions/AUDITONOMOUS_DEFINITION.md:57 reads "[source text withheld from the public copy]". ROADMAP carries the same blob (8b934b4).
- MAIN:L8/L4/work/experiments/0.md:36 reads "Nothing is filed at this position; the position is admissible and empty. No experiment has been executed". The blob (a86e481) is identical in MAIN, ROADMAP and BETA, and 0.md is the only file in that directory in each state.
- The sheet L8/L4/work/0.md:43 says in all three states: "No implemented system, experiment, or measurement is claimed."
- BETA:L8/L4/work/computation/auditonomous_beta_result.json (parsed, not re-run): 16 inputs, 16 traces, 32 events, 32 records; environment.synthetic and model.synthetic are both true.
- BETA:L8/L5/research/findings/AUDITONOMOUS_BETA_FINDINGS.md:11 reads "[source text withheld from the public copy]."

WRONG OR IMPRECISE
1. "The definition says so itself" is overstated. Line 57 disclaims achievement; it does not say that no test record exists. It says the eBIOS corpus has its own "compliance, proof-status, and validation statements", which it calls "[source text withheld from the public copy]". MAIN:...DEFINITION.md:64 even cites an eBIOS test docstring: "[source text withheld from the public copy]. Those tests live in abba-01/ebios, not in this repository. The plain "nothing tested, nothing built" statement comes from the two sheets, not from the definition.
2. The line 57 locator is true of MAIN and ROADMAP only. BETA's definition is a different blob (8127041, 16 lines added on 2026-11-03) and the same sentence is at line 59.
3. "No record tests any system against the definition" holds only for executed tests. Desk comparisons of named systems against the definition do exist:
   - All three states, in the definition itself: MAIN:...DEFINITION.md:47 and :252 (BETA :49 and :254) read eBIOS's own documents against the firmware clause — "no firmware artifact exists in the corpus".
   - ROADMAP only: Auditonomous_Theory_Master_Archive.md:312-314 maps NASA DSA/Starling — "[source text withheld from the public copy]", then "the absent clause ... no mandatory auditability".
   - ROADMAP only: the same file at :486 and Block_40_The_Wetware_Instance.md:25 — "[source text withheld from the public copy]."
   These are authorial prose (INTERNAL ONLY; the SpudCell passage is labelled by Block 40 "resonance, not evidence"), not test records. Each concludes non-satisfaction.
4. BETA does run something against part of the definition's apparatus. The fixture is checked against two selected predicates, C6 stop and C7 record, taken from AUDITON_ENVELOPE. Findings :9 says "selected task execution is demonstrated" and that applying the complete senses "remains **unresolved**". The result's limitations say these [source text withheld from the public copy]".
5. "Every achievement flag false" needs one qualifier. The /claims object has five keys: four *_achieved flags, all false, and standards_autonomy, which is the string "unresolved" rather than a boolean.
6. "BETA's one computation" is imprecise. BETA:L8/L4/work/computation/0.md:38-44 lists the fixture plus six inherited outputs (three requirements extractions, a deep-research run and its two exports). The fixture is the only executed code in BETA.
7. ROADMAP holds other code that the claim does not mention: eight numerical probes and a reconstructed OMMP codec with test_ommp.py. Their sheets say "None was re-run in the restoring pass" and "RECONSTRUCTION — NOT CANONICAL". None tests a system against the definition, so they do not refute the claim, but "experiments are empty" should not be read as "no code exists".

- I did not execute test_auditonomous_beta.py or regenerate the result; my task did not authorise a run.
- The pinned producer commit 805cd42 exists in /home/user/autonomous on origin/beta/7lm-exemplar-autonomous; I did not compare its bytes to the recorded hashes.

- UNRESOLVED for "any system is auditonomous": no executed test of an implemented system exists, and BETA labels the full application "unresolved".
- EMPTY for the experiments position in all three states.
- INTERNALLY CHECKED, synthetic and bounded, for the BETA fixture's two selected predicates.

Every cited locator checks out verbatim, but three parts of the claim are imprecise or overstated.

CONFIRMED
- MAIN:README.md:11 reads "The L0 object, the active definition of record (AU-NORM-02): `L8/L0/semantics/definitions/AUDITONOMOUS_DEFINITION.md`." The entry's header (MAIN:L8/L0/semantics/definitions/AUDITONOMOUS_DEFINITION.md:3) says "Developed 2026-07-30".
- AU-NORM-02 is recorded as an owner ruling at MAIN:L8/L6/history/LEDGER_2026-08-16_l6-close-and-normalization.md:32 ("Active definition of the coined word: ... AU-NORM-02). Root `AUDITONOMOUS.md` is history-only by ruling.") and in the message of commit 4a1c1db ("owner rulings AU-NORM-01..04"). No standalone ruling text exists in any of the three states; a search for AU-NORM-02 returns only ledger, sheet and README references.
- ROADMAP:L8/L0/semantics/definitions/AUDITONOMY.md:3-5 reads as quoted. The blob (79b35ee) is byte-identical to HISTORY 1d83788:manuscripts/definitions/AUDITONOMY.md; it was restored at 62d2e3f on 2026-09-14. Its internal dates are 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-05 only.
- AUDITONOMY.md is absent from the MAIN and BETA trees and from every other remote ref at the L0 path. It is also absent from all three refs of the autonomous repository.
- MAIN:L8/L5/research/findings/DISTILLATION.md:21 reads "(`definitions/AUDITONOMY.md`, governing text)".

IMPRECISE OR OVERSTATED
1. "Two texts claim to be the definition" blurs two headwords. The 30 July text is "AUDITONOMOUS — the defining entry" for the adjective (MAIN: DEF:1, :14). AUDITONOMY.md is "TERM ENTRY — AUDITONOMY" for the noun (ROADMAP: AUD:1, :17 "THE DEFINITION", :67 "Canonical definition."). They do overlap, in both directions:
   - DEF:28 glosses the noun: "auditonomy: bounded autonomy under mandatory auditability".
   - AUD:69 defines it differently: "[source text withheld from the public copy]".
   - AUD also says what an auditonomous system is (AUD:143, and AUD:197 "[source text withheld from the public copy]"), which matches none of DEF's three senses.

2. "No document states their relation" is false of ROADMAP as worded. Three ROADMAP documents state a headword relation:
   - ROADMAP:L8/L0/semantics/definitions/0.md:32 and :34 call DEF "the locally authored definition of *auditonomous* (adj.) ... the active record" and AUD "TERM ENTRY — AUDITONOMY, the derived noun".
   - ROADMAP:L8/L0/0.md:93 lists both as "The two L0 objects this repository authors".
   - ROADMAP vocabulary paper :20, :48 and :104 treat DEF as "the entry of record" and AUD as the noun's "term entry (the L0 object)".
   What holds is narrower: no document says which text controls where they overlap, and neither text cites the other (searches of each for the other's name return nothing). Decision D20 (ROADMAP:BOOK_STRUCTURE_AND_ROADMAP_2026-09-13.md:630) ranks three framings of auditonomy and does not include DEF. On MAIN and BETA no relation can be stated because AUDITONOMY.md is not there.

3. AU-NORM-02 does not adjudicate between these two texts. It ranked the 30 July entry over the consolidated root AUDITONOMOUS.md of 2026-08-04. AUDITONOMY.md had been deleted at 8c98573 on 2026-08-15 (462 deletions) and was not in the tree at the ruling commit 4a1c1db.

Every ref, hash, date and ancestry fact in the claim checks out. Four parts are imprecise or overstated.

- 7lm `origin/beta/common-contracts-r1-r6` is 97314c5 (2026-11-03 08:58 -0800); it is not an ancestor of main; the merge-base is 2e5a6d6.
- 4ca3edb is the beta's first commit and is in no branch but the beta.

- `## Manuscript work` appears only at 7LM-BETA:`L8/L4/work/writing/0.md:12`; no such heading exists in any state of auditonomous or autonomous.
- The mirror commits f2d5b37 (auditonomous) and 8257118 (autonomous), both 11 Nov 2026 UTC, sit directly on `origin/main`; neither BETA nor ROADMAP is an ancestor of the session branch.

**Corrections**
1. **"Three candidate states" undercounts.** 7lm has three more unmerged heads, none in main or the beta:
   - `origin/audit/peering-descriptive-reframe-2026-09-20` (3555866): 122 commits, 79 files, mostly the owner's descriptive reframe of 20 Sep.
   - `origin/ccr-00099fac-hjosbo` (b5c3984): 8 commits.

The repository calls R1–R6 "corrections", not contracts (7LM-BETA:`L8/L6/history/specification-history.md:104-106`: "after the owner's approval of R1–R6").
